purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined urban transit station whose passenger, platform, service, and vertical-circulation logic remains legible.
architectural_rules: Street entry must progress coherently through ticket/gate space to passenger circulation and platform access.
Platform geometry must clearly imply a transport right-of-way even when track or guideway sections are ruined.
At least two distinguishable egress paths must exist where the footprint and station type plausibly require them.
Operations and utility spaces must be adjacent to but controlled from public passenger circulation.
Vertical circulation openings must be structurally framed and must not terminate into solid floors or unsupported voids.
The station must read as transit infrastructure rather than a generic underground hall.

damage_doctrine.intent: Transit infrastructure damaged and abandoned while preserving route legibility and strong infrastructural identity.
